facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Focus: AI, robotics, defense, space, marketplaces, fintech, computational biology, climate, software
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Typically US$1M–2M SAFE for 15% on generic FAST; specialized FAST terms vary
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 有明确创业团队/项目，能说明产品、市场和团队；核心技术/产品与项目垂直领域匹配；公司阶段应处于早期，通常不应已明显超出 seed 阶段
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 US / Europe-focused 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.International Founder: 可能接受国际 founder；需确认签证/现场要求
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Status: Current generic cycle closed / future FASTs recur
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 硬件 / 机器人 / DeepTech；MedTech / Health / Bio；AI / AI-native；Fintech；Climate / Energy；阶段以 Pre-seed–seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目
facts_raw.Notes: Not a classic accelerator but high-signal VC self-run founder program. Avoid for pure hardware/medical devices under NFX's stated generic preferences.

facts.Focus: AI, robotics, defense, space, marketplaces, fintech, computational biology, climate, software
facts.Funding / Support: Typically US$1M–2M SAFE for 15% on generic FAST; specialized FAST terms vary
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: An identifiable team or project with a clear explanation of its product, market and founders; The core technology or product must match the program vertical; The company should be early-stage, generally no later than seed
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.
facts.On-site / Attendance: No standard attendance requirement published. Confirm the current cohort arrangements for US / Europe-focused.
facts.International Founder: International founders may be eligible; confirm visa and attendance requirements.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must independently confirm lawful entry and stay for US or European activities.
facts.Application Status: Current generic cycle closed / future FASTs recur
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Hardware / Robotics / DeepTech; MedTech / Health / Bio; AI / AI-native; Fintech; Climate / Energy; primarily at the Pre-seed–seed stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses
facts.Notes: Not a classic accelerator but high-signal VC self-run founder program. Avoid for pure hardware/medical devices under NFX's stated generic preferences.
